'''Sporting Clube Farense''', simply known as '''Farense''', is a Portuguese professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Faro, Portugal|Faro]] in the [[Faro (Portuguese district)|district of the same name]] and the region of [[Algarve]]. Founded in 1910, the club currently plays in the [[Liga Portugal 2]]."}}
